text:
Nora: quick design thread re: modal footer buttons + toast overlap in dashboard. on small widths the primary and secondary buttons stack and the global toast appears behind them (z-index issue).
Ben: reproed on mobile breakpoint. toast lands with z-index: 800 and modal footer seems to be 900. toast should always be on top or toast should be anchored inside modal when action originates there.
Sofia: can we avoid changing global z-indexs? Suggest two options: 1) render toasts in a portal thats parented to document.body with z-index token --z-toast-top (higher than modals) 2) when toast triggered from inside a modal, render an inline micro-toast inside the modal footer so it's obviously related.
Rex: option 2 is nice for context (e.g., "Saved" next to the Save button). but for global system alerts we still need top-layer portal. we should standardize token names: --z-modal = 900, --z-toast = 1000 (or --z-toast-top for portal).
Nora: good call. also UX nit: when buttons stack, spacing-token between stacked buttons felt tight. current token: --space-btn-vertical: 6px. propose 10px for small screens so buttons don't feel cramped.
Ben: +1. small change but could affect several flows. prefer to add responsive token mapping: --space-btn-vertical-mobile: 10px, default:6px.
Sofia: accessibility: when inline micro-toast appears inside modal, ensure it's announced with `role="status" aria-live="polite"`, and provide `aria-hidden=true` for decorative icons. Also keyboard focus should remain on the button that triggered the action.
Rex: copy update: current toast text is "Saved" which is ambiguous. For modal actions use contextual copy: "Saved deployment settings" or "API key rotated" depending on trigger. We should keep a short noun + verb pattern.
Nora: plan: Ben -> prototype toast portal token change + responsive spacing token; Sofia -> implement inline micro-toast component for modal context + a11y attributes; Rex -> audit copy strings and add examples to toast copy library. I'll raise a token MR if we confirm values.
DesignBot: created ticket DS-1107 and PR draft #2402.
Ben: timeline: can ship a small patch to dev by tomorrow that changes toast portal z-token and adds mobile spacing token.
Sofia: i'll add tests for screenreader announce and reduced-motion preference for micro-toast.
Rex: updating copy doc now and will post snippets here.
Nora: thanks team. will follow up on token MR after we validate visual diffs.
DesignBot: Reminder: component check-in Monday 9am.
